milestones.title: M0 — Pilot scope and provider access
milestones.description: Validate one Chilean pickup use case and prove WhatsApp, hosted checkout and external kitchen-order access for BOTH Toteat and Fudo. Exit: signed-off bilingual flow, sandbox credentials, provider-specific evidence and recorded payment decisions.

milestones.title: M1 — Modular foundation and local demo
milestones.description: Runnable TypeScript modular monolith: shared tenant/catalog/order capabilities, WhatsApp ordering, simulated payment and POS adapters, Spanish demo and pickup dashboard. Exit: repeatable demo and automated critical-path checks; simulations visibly labeled.

milestones.title: M2 — Real WhatsApp ordering
milestones.description: Real Meta test-number ordering with durable bilingual messaging, local kitchen fulfillment and pay at pickup. Add independently verified Webpay sandbox without POS prerequisites. Exit: prospect-demo evidence in P24; restaurant POS acceptance remains later work.

milestones.title: M3 — Payments and kitchen integration
milestones.description: Implement BOTH Toteat and Fudo adapters with verified hosted checkout per restaurant. Exit: sandbox payments reconcile server-side, exactly one kitchen order per selected provider, readiness reconciliation, provider parity tests and failure recovery.

milestones.title: M4 — Customer demo and Chile pilot readiness
milestones.description: Regional staging, bilingual authenticated pickup dashboard, runbooks, acceptance rehearsal and restaurant pilot gate. Exit: customer feedback recorded, both POS systems verified, and no unresolved payment, duplicate-order, privacy or pickup blockers.

issues.title: Validate the first restaurant pickup workflow
criteria: Interview the owner and kitchen lead; record current WhatsApp order volume, missed orders, pickup timing and POS/version.
Select one restaurant, branch, currency CLP, Spanish copy, operating hours and an initial small menu.
Agree measurable demo and pilot success criteria and who handles cancellations and paid-but-unaccepted orders.

issues.title: Prove access to both Toteat and Fudo for the initial pilot
criteria: Obtain owner-authorized sandbox accounts for both providers and record restaurant/branch/account capabilities without committing credentials.
For Toteat, verify products, shift status, external paid pickup creation, status lookup and webhook authenticity; record external ID duplicate/timeout behavior.

For Fudo, obtain external-order integration approval and confirm the required Delivery module; prove product mappings, order injection and status notifications. General API access alone is insufficient.
Record capability evidence and sanitized fixtures separately for both providers; both are initial-pilot requirements. Do not label the pilot ready while either provider remains unverified.

issues.title: Prove hosted payment-link capability and merchant settlement
criteria: For both Toteat and Fudo, establish whether the authorized integration can create a hosted checkout for external pickup orders, including expiry, payment verification and refunds.
Public Toteat order payment fields are accounting input, not evidence of a checkout-link API. Record evidence of the supported flow.

Where either POS cannot create checkout links, obtain owner agreement for a Chile-supported merchant gateway (e.g. Webpay or Mercado Pago), with settlement to the restaurant and correct payment-method mapping for each POS.
Approve the payment-before-POS sequence and timeout/refund runbook. No real payment adapter until this decision is recorded.

issues.title: Review the Spanish customer flow and pickup dashboard with the restaurant
criteria: Use the local simulation to rehearse greeting → menu → cart edits → total → checkout → kitchen acceptance → pickup.
Review Spanish copy, unavailable items, allergens handoff, expected preparation time and receipt expectations with the restaurant.
Record feedback and pilot commitment; freeze the smallest menu and flow before building a full owner platform.

issues.title: Establish the TypeScript modular monolith and repeatable local demo
criteria: Deliver shared tenant/catalog/order services and independent WhatsApp, payment and POS boundaries; QR module remains disabled.
Provide Node setup, lockfile, environment example, CI type checks and end-to-end critical-path tests.
Deliver browser chat simulation, explicit fake payment/kitchen states and pickup counts in es-CL.
Run documented checks and demonstrate a restart resets data; never describe this in-memory baseline as pilot-ready.
Provide Spanish-default and English UI/conversation support with an explicit language selector, locale-aware CLP formatting and no cart loss when changing language.

issues.title: Replace demo storage with PostgreSQL and enforce restaurant access
criteria: Implement migrations, seed command, repositories, authenticated owner/staff roles and server-side tenant/branch mapping.
Persist catalog, sessions, order lines, payment attempts, provider references, inbox/outbox and audit events; use tenant-scoped constraints.
Test cross-tenant reads/writes and provider callbacks cannot access another restaurant; no tenant ID accepted from a customer's message.
Verify restart recovery and transaction rollback. Replace shared demo key with real staff authentication before staging handles customer data.

issues.title: Import the pilot catalog and enforce service availability
criteria: Map both providers' product/modifier identifiers to the shared catalog, including Spanish and English display names; store integer CLP totals and a versioned price quote.
Reject sold-out items, unsupported modifiers, closed shifts and out-of-hours checkout; reconfirm price changes.
Support manual seed/import as an explicit pilot fallback with restaurant approval; WhatsApp must not require QR-menu entitlement.
Provide an operator correction flow and test mapping drift, stale catalog and invalid product IDs.
issues.externalAcceptance: Requires authorized Toteat/Fudo fixtures and restaurant approval from #2/#4.

issues.title: Implement durable order states, quotes and transactional events
criteria: Separate order, payment and POS submission states, with immutable confirmed lines, totals, quote expiry and source attribution.
Persist idempotency keys and inbox/outbox events in the same transaction as order changes.
Support payment_pending, paid, pos_pending, accepted, preparing, ready, collected, cancelled and needs_attention outcomes without illegal transitions.
Test concurrent confirmations and retries; a payment success must not imply restaurant acceptance.

issues.title: Connect the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API test account
criteria: Configure a business app, test sender, permitted recipients, messages subscription and public HTTPS callback.
Store app secret, verification token and access token in environment/secret storage; pin a supported Graph API version from the app.
Demonstrate one signed inbound greeting and outbound Spanish menu to a permitted test recipient; redact phone numbers and tokens from evidence.
Record token lifetime/rotation and the supported messaging window/template requirements; the WhatsApp Business app alone is not the webhook API.
issues.scopeNote: POS access is not required for the real-phone prospect demo; retain the existing Business mobile number.

issues.title: Make signed WhatsApp webhooks durable and retryable
criteria: Verify HMAC against exact raw request bytes, map receiving phone ID to tenant, and reject unknown accounts.
Commit a uniquely keyed inbound event before returning success; process asynchronously with per-conversation serialization.
Persist outbound work, bounded retry/backoff, delivery statuses, dead-letter visibility and message/session retention.
Test batched/status/media payloads, replay, restart, concurrent delivery, expired tokens and provider timeout; no raw bodies or phone numbers in application logs.

issues.title: Build the Spanish WhatsApp menu, cart and confirmation journey
criteria: Respond to an initial greeting or unsupported input with help and menu; support item selection, quantity, removal, review and explicit confirmation.
Use bounded interactive lists/buttons with pagination where appropriate and text fallbacks; catalog owns prices and availability.
Show final CLP total and pickup expectations before creating a single checkout; recover an existing unpaid checkout on repeated confirmation.
Test sold-out changes, quote expiry, repeated replies, stale buttons, session expiry and a new order. No generative AI is required for this POC.
Default conversations to Spanish; support explicit English/Español commands and localized menu/cart/checkout messages without altering the order or total.

issues.title: Add staff handoff and permitted pickup notifications
criteria: Provide a human-help path for unknown requests, allergy questions, payment exceptions and rejected orders.
Send payment received, restaurant accepted and ready-for-pickup notifications only from verified domain state.
Enforce the applicable customer-service window; use an approved utility template outside it or route to staff.
Test failed delivery, late readiness, and no marketing messages or sensitive payment data in chat.

issues.title: Implement the Toteat catalog and paid-pickup adapter
criteria: Implement the Toteat adapter for restaurant-scoped credentials, menu mappings, open-shift check and external paid pickup submission. Fudo is implemented separately in P22.
Use verified base URLs and provider product/payment IDs, external correlation and accepted response references.
Contract-test sanitized provider fixtures, 4xx/429/5xx, closed shift, unknown products and mapping mismatch.
Prove a paid sandbox order appears in the Toteat restaurant's actual kitchen workflow, with payment-method mapping and pickup semantics confirmed by staff.

issues.title: Implement the approved hosted checkout adapter
criteria: Create a server-priced checkout with tenant, order, amount, currency, expiry and unique merchant reference.
Send an opaque HTTPS application checkout link in WhatsApp whose landing page POSTs token_ws to the allowlisted provider-hosted sandbox URL; never collect card data in our app.
Persist sandbox attempt/environment/order/session references and implement server-side commit/status verification. Production merchant credentials and settlement require P03 before activation.
Test expiry, abandoned checkout, duplicate requests and gateway errors. Clearly distinguish sandbox from production and record who receives settlement.
issues.scopeNote: Webpay integration-environment checkout is approved independently of POS; P03 gates production merchant settlement. Current network probe returned security-page HTTP 403 before API response; no checkout/payment proven.

issues.title: Reconcile verified payments and submit paid orders once
criteria: Accept payment only after authenticating the notification and verifying amount, currency, merchant, order reference and authoritative provider status.
Atomically mark paid and schedule POS work, routing to the tenant's configured Toteat or Fudo adapter; browser returns, chat messages and demo endpoints cannot mark production orders paid.
Handle duplicate/out-of-order payment events, late settlement, checkout expiry and concurrent workers without duplicate fulfillment.
Test wrong totals/merchants, forged callbacks, paid-before-callback, provider timeout and paid-but-POS-failed exception visibility.

issues.title: Reconcile POS submission retries and kitchen status updates
criteria: Authenticate provider callbacks according to the actual provider contract; persist and deduplicate inbound changes.
Reconcile unknown submission outcomes by external reference before retry; do not assume provider-side idempotency exists.
If authoritative lookup/idempotency is unavailable, park uncertain orders for staff review instead of blind resubmission.
Map accepted, rejected, preparing, ready and collected states with polling fallback where supported; test duplicate callbacks and missed/out-of-order events.

issues.title: Implement cancellation, refund and reconciliation exceptions
criteria: Agree staff authority and cutoff for cancel/reject/refund; preserve an audit trail and gateway refund references.
Make paid-but-rejected or late-paid orders visible with an actionable owner, customer notification and escalation timer.
Reconcile daily provider payments, local orders and POS references; surface missing/duplicate discrepancies.
Test refund failure, partial/duplicate notifications and cancellation racing payment; the dashboard must not count refunded money as net sales.

issues.title: Deliver the authenticated restaurant pickup logistics dashboard
criteria: Show WhatsApp-sourced pickup counts, paid/refunded amounts, accepted/preparing/ready/collected queues and integration exceptions.
Filter by restaurant-local date in America/Santiago and branch; amounts are CLP and labels es-CL.

Allow permitted staff to acknowledge pickup with audit history; show freshness/failures and independently selectable Spanish-default or English UI, including labels, actions, empty/error states and product display names.
Test empty/busy/mobile states, authorization and cross-tenant access; dashboard totals reconcile to the order/payment ledger.

issues.title: Deploy isolated Santiago staging with database and secret management
criteria: Prepare reviewed infrastructure for Cloud Run and Cloud SQL PostgreSQL in southamerica-west1 after verifying service options and cost.
Provide HTTPS webhooks, separate staging/production secrets, least-privilege identities, migrations, health checks and rollback.
Configure durable queue execution, database backups/restore rehearsal and redacted telemetry; no process-local correctness assumptions.
Document deploy/rollback commands and estimated operating cost; prove simulated routes are disabled in real pilot mode.

issues.title: Prepare pilot privacy, support and operational controls
criteria: Inventory personal data, restaurant access, subprocessors, retention/deletion and incident contacts; review Chile-specific obligations with appropriate local advice.
Separate transactional ordering permission from optional marketing consent; collect only contact details needed for pickup.
Document secret rotation, backup recovery, webhook outage, manual order recovery and paid-but-unaccepted response ownership.
Rehearse a shift handover and incident; no raw payment details, secrets or full customer messages in telemetry.

issues.title: Run customer demo, sandbox acceptance and the Chile pilot go/no-go
criteria: Rehearse the demo separately for Toteat and Fudo using a permitted real WhatsApp recipient, approved sandbox checkout, actual restaurant kitchen confirmation and reconciled dashboard totals. Both providers are required for initial-pilot sign-off.
Record evidence for duplicate inbound/payment events, closed kitchen, sold-out product, gateway failure, POS timeout, ready notification and pickup.
Obtain restaurant sign-off on menu, totals, promised pickup timing, staff ownership, support window and live-mode limitations.

Start only after provider access and payment/refund gates pass; review completion rate, time to acceptance, zero duplicate fulfillment, reconciliation exceptions and owner feedback before expanding scope.
Repeat the customer demo in English for the founder and Spanish for the restaurant; language changes must preserve cart/order state, CLP currency and Santiago business dates.

issues.title: Implement the approved Fudo external-order and catalog adapter
criteria: Use Fudo's approved external-order integration and a Delivery-enabled test account; do not infer order-injection permission from Pro/general API access.
Implement tenant-scoped authentication, product/modifier mapping, paid pickup creation, integration order references and provider-specific status callbacks from the authorized contract.
Map hosted-gateway settlement/payment method to the Fudo order without charging twice; prove pickup reaches the correct Delivery/kitchen workflow.
Contract-test sanitized success/rejection/429/timeout fixtures and obtain restaurant confirmation of one paid sandbox kitchen order. Block live mode until approval and all contract evidence exist.

issues.title: Verify restaurant provider selection and Toteat/Fudo acceptance parity
criteria: Persist one selected POS per restaurant/branch with separately scoped credentials and mapping; route each order to exactly that connector. Never submit one order to both POS systems.
Run the same shared adapter suite against Toteat and Fudo fixtures: correct CLP totals, modifiers, paid pickup, duplicate replay, acceptance/readiness and uncertain outcomes.
Demonstrate two sandbox restaurant configurations through the full WhatsApp/payment/kitchen/dashboard flow, one for each provider, with no data/credential crossover.
Document provider-specific limitations and verify switching providers cannot reroute already-confirmed orders; no silent fallback to another restaurant or provider.

issues.title: Deliver the POS-independent WhatsApp demo and pay-at-pickup fallback
issues.estimate: Re-estimate after state and API access checks
criteria: Configure explicit local kitchen fulfillment with no simulated vendor references or required POS mappings.
Separate payment method/state from fulfillment; allow unpaid pay-at-pickup orders to be accepted/prepared/ready.
Persist immutable totals, one ticket, audited scoped staff actions and recovery across retries/restarts.
Prove real WhatsApp menu/cart/confirmation in Spanish and English using durable inbox/outbox delivery.
Rehearse pay at pickup through accepted/preparing/ready, store payment and collection.
Add Webpay sandbox creation, hosted test-card payment and authoritative commit/status verification; test decline/cancel/expiry/replay/unknown outcomes.
Show local fulfillment, separate unpaid/test-authorized/store-paid amounts and reconciled pickup counts.
Require explicit safe payment-method changes and prevent late authorization/double collection.
Use supervised public HTTPS with synthetic data first; obtain hosting budget/access before unattended staging.
issues.scopeNote: First prospect-demo acceptance. Both-provider restaurant/POS pilot gates remain later work.

scopeUpdate: 2026-10-28: first prospect demo uses local kitchen fulfillment, pay at pickup and independently verified Webpay sandbox; no restaurant POS account required. Both Toteat and Fudo remain subsequent restaurant-pilot integrations.

implemented_slices: P10/P12: scoped recovery, signed status evidence, verified reply/notification windows and redacted human handoff; real-phone acceptance and retention remain open
P14/P15/P17/P24: opt-in durable sandbox checkout/local ticket/status/full test reversal, fixture and browser evidence; real hosted success and merchant settlement remain open
P13/P22/P23: factual provider access matrix and synthetic port tests; no vendor contracts or kitchen acceptance claimed
P18/P20/P21: bilingual staff controls, HTTP/browser/image/isolated restore evidence and operations runbook; restaurant feedback, retention policy and paid staging remain gated

validation.chromium: ES/EN owner/operator/viewer desktop/mobile; fake sandbox POST/reversal
